flags.question: What are the URLs of the top 3 most favorited tweets containing links?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Link)
WITH t
ORDER BY t.favorites DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN t.url
details: Cypher accesses t.url but "url" is not on :Tweet (exists on other types)

flags.question: List the top 3 tweets from 'Neo4j' that have been retweeted more than 100 times.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)
WHERE t.favorites > 100
RETURN t.text, t.favorites
ORDER BY t.favorites DESC
LIMIT 3
details: TypeQL uses reduce...count but Cypher has no COUNT()
